hypothesis: A filtered Linked block (at most 5 titles) makes sessions open the linked memory they need, with no more friction.
unit: A segment with at least one pack event whose nb is non-empty; assignment is per segment, so every metric is aggregated per segment first.

metric.primary: linked_read_share: the share of units in which any nb path was Read later in the same segment.

stop_rule: Decide at min_n units per arm or at max_days; no early stop for gain. Stop early for harm when, after at least 30 units per arm, correction cues per 100 prompts on-arm exceed off-arm by more than 50% relative.
decision: Default on ([links] linked_block = true, arm closed) only if the on minus off read share is at least +0.10, a one-sided Fisher exact p is below 0.10, and on-arm cues per 100 prompts are at most 1.2 times off. Otherwise off, and the code stays for doctor and Obsidian. Inconclusive at max_days (n short) means off.
caveat: A read is a proxy and can reward distraction, which is why the cue guard is part of the decision. About 10 segments a day, half with a pack and neighbours (unverified), so min_n takes about 4 weeks.
